[[File:Mind Altar Teleport icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''Mind Altar Teleport''' teleports the caster to the entrance of the [[Mind Altar]].

In order to cast this spell, players must have spoken to [[Tyss]] to unlock the [[Arceuus spellbook]].

Potential uses of the teleport include retrieving a lost [[Dwarf Cannon]] from the nearby [[Dwarven Mine]], accessing the [[Ruins of Camdozaal]] and [[The Whisperer]] after completing [[Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire]], speaking to the [[Oracle]] for a [[clue scroll]], or quick crafting of [[Mind rune]]s.
